claims: The Artemis II mission lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission lifted off from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Complex 39B in Florida.
The rocket successfully launched four astronauts on the Artemis II mission.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission around the moon.
The Artemis II launch was initially targeted for 6:24 p.m. EDT.
Artemis II is the first crewed moon mission in 53 years.
